title: Can Place Flowers
summary: Given an array representing a flowerbed where 0 indicates an empty plot and 1 indicates a plot with a flower, and an integer n, determine if n new flowers can be planted such that no two flowers are adjacent.
statement: Given an array representing a flowerbed where 0 indicates an empty plot and 1 indicates a plot with a flower, and an integer n, determine if n new flowers can be planted such that no two flowers are adjacent. Return true if possible, otherwise false.
hints: A flower only needs its two immediate neighbors empty.
Scan left to right; a greedy placement cannot block a better earlier placement.
Pad with zero sentinels, plant whenever three consecutive cells are zero, and decrement n.
Taking the earliest legal plot leaves at least as much room to its right as skipping it, so the greedy scan is optimal.

tests.explanation: Plant in the middle empty plot, yielding a valid arrangement.
After the middle placement no other plot has both neighbors empty.
